main_text.p: literas servet, vestram gubernationem & totam vitam optata prosperitate ornet, ut pietatis & virtutis praemia etiam in hac vita illustria percipiatis. Benè valete, Stadæ, Nonis Decembris anno Jesu Christi 1582.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a mask with scrolls) below the signature; not transcribed. The text is in italic type. "V. A." is set in large initials. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "Benè" and "Studiosè" carry a grave accent as printed. Parts of the page are faint and show-through from the reverse is visible in the right margin, not transcribed.
